Class CashierView

java.lang.Object
com.squad83.views.CashierView
public class CashierView extends Object
Cashier view for building and submitting customer orders.

Menu items are loaded from the database as buttons grouped by category. The cashier picks the size, sugar level, and ice level, adds drinks to the order, and checks out with a cashier name, payment method, and optional tip. Submitting saves one row to orders, one row per line to order_items, and subtracts each drink's recipe from inventory, all in one transaction.

    • loadMenu

      private static void loadMenu()
      Loads all active menu items and shows each as a button, grouped under a heading for its category. Clicking a button adds that drink to the order.

    • loadEmployees

      private static void loadEmployees()
      Loads all active employees into the cashier drop-down.

    • addToCart

      private static void addToCart(CashierView.MenuOption option)
      Adds a drink to the order using the currently selected size, sugar, and ice. If the same drink with the same options is already in the order, its quantity goes up by one instead. Large drinks cost the base price plus the large upcharge.
      Parameters:
      option - the menu item that was clicked

    • changeQuantity

      private static void changeQuantity(int change)
      Changes the quantity of the selected order line. A line whose quantity drops to zero is removed.
      Parameters:
      change - the amount to add to the quantity, such as 1 or -1

    • removeItem

      private static void removeItem()
      Removes the selected line from the order, or shows an error if none is selected.

    • clearOrder

      private static void clearOrder()
      Empties the order, clears the tip, and resets the payment method to card.

    • getSubtotal

      private static BigDecimal getSubtotal()
      Adds up the line totals of every item in the order.
      Returns:
      the order subtotal, rounded to cents

    • getTax

      private static BigDecimal getTax(BigDecimal subtotal)
      Calculates sales tax on a subtotal.
      Parameters:
      subtotal - the order subtotal
      Returns:
      the tax, rounded to cents

    • getTip

      private static BigDecimal getTip()
      Reads the tip from the tip field. An empty field counts as no tip.
      Returns:
      the tip rounded to cents, or null if the text is not a valid non-negative number

    • updateTotals

      private static void updateTotals()
      Recalculates the subtotal, tax, and total and updates their labels. An invalid tip is treated as zero here; it is rejected when the order is submitted.

    • submitOrder

      private static void submitOrder()
      Validates the order, asks for confirmation, and saves it in one transaction: one row in orders, one row per line in order_items, and the recipe amounts subtracted from inventory, never going below zero. If any step fails, the whole transaction is rolled back and nothing is saved.
